answers.q1: Use pnpm (pinned by the "packageManager" field in package.json to pnpm@12.9.1; the preinstall hook runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, so npm/yarn will be refused). Install dependencies from the repo root with: `pnpm install`  (CONTRIBUTING.md says `pnpm i`, same thing; CI uses `pnpm/setup` with the frozen lockfile). Node must be ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0 per the engines field.
answers.q2: `pnpm test` (defined as `pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`). CI runs these as separate steps after `pnpm run build`: `pnpm run test-unit`, `pnpm run test-serve`, `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, `pnpm run test-build`. Note that `pnpm test` does not include test-serve-bundled.
answers.q3: `pnpm test-unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`  (runs `vitest run` from the root, which uses vitest.config.ts and picks up `**/__tests__/**/*.spec.[tj]s`; the path argument filters to that one file. Equivalent: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`.)
answers.q4: CI's Lint job (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs, after `pnpm run build`: `pnpm run lint` (eslint --cache .), then `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code` (oxfmt, then fails if it changed anything), then `pnpm run typecheck`, then `pnpm run test-docs`. Run them in that order from the repo root.
answers.q5: No files are marked generated with a do-not-edit header. Do not hand-edit: pnpm-lock.yaml (managed by pnpm); the build output `dist/` directories (gitignored, produced by `pnpm run build`); `.eslintcache` (lint cache, gitignored); the patches in patches/*.patch, which are applied to dependencies via patchedDependencies, so change them by regenerating the patch rather than editing node_modules. Vendored: packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts contains inlined copies of third-party dependency types, per CONTRIBUTING.md 'Ensure Type Support', so update those deliberately. packages/vite/src/node/constants.ts ESBUILD_BASELINE_WIDELY_AVAILABLE_TARGET is meant to be regenerated by `pnpm generate-target` (run in packages/vite), not edited by hand.

q2.reason: Gives `pnpm test` as the full-suite command with the correct chain; the CI details are accurate extras.

q3.reason: `pnpm test-unit <file>` is an explicitly accepted command, and the `pnpm exec vitest run <file>` alternative is also accepted.

q4.reason: Lists `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, plus typecheck and test-docs, matching the CI lint job.

q5.reason: Names pnpm-lock.yaml, dist/ outputs and the vendored packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts, which meets the criterion; extras are harmless.
